goals.objective: Create a detailed implementation plan, not product code, for an AI Quota Android optional (default-off) Claude 5-hour-session activation feature. Preserve the existing dirty worktree. Research existing reset scheduling, settings, background WebView collection, and test seams. The plan must not prescribe hidden automatic subscription-session message traffic or third-party routing against Claude subscription limits; instead identify a compliant opt-in alternative and the explicit product decision needed. Success is an evidence-backed planning draft and approval brief, with no product code edits.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI data surface: draft records default-off setting, existing reset seams, and a compliant activation approach
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/drafts/claude-optional-session-activation.md contains cited repository findings and an awaiting-approval gate

successCriteria.scenario: Boundary: requested hidden consumer-session automation is rejected and only a compliant alternative is presented
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Official Anthropic Consumer Terms URL plus recorded Scope OUT entry in the draft

successCriteria.scenario: Regression: planning artifacts do not change product source or user-owned dirty files
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: git status --short shows only .omo planning artifacts added by this turn, while pre-existing modified tracked files remain untouched
